b2-35-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Rising Prices
b2-35-01.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks what worries families in the news. Prices have gone up.
b2-35-01.prompt: Tell Carlos what worries families, using a noun.
b2-35-01.target: El aumento de los precios preocupa a muchas familias.
b2-35-01.english: The rise in prices worries many families.
b2-35-01.canDo: I can turn a verb into a noun, such as *aumentar* into *el aumento*, in formal writing.

b2-35-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Minister's Visit
b2-35-02.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks how a news report says that the minister is expected tomorrow.
b2-35-02.prompt: Say it as a newspaper would.
b2-35-02.target: Se espera que el ministro llegue mañana.
b2-35-02.english: The minister is expected to arrive tomorrow.
b2-35-02.canDo: I can report a fact impersonally with *se estima que* and *se espera que*.

b2-35-03.title: Communicative Challenge: A Plan with Advantages
b2-35-03.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos says the plan is expensive. You agree, but you want to point out its advantages.
b2-35-03.prompt: Grant that the plan is expensive, then say what it offers.
b2-35-03.target: Si bien es cierto que el plan es caro, ofrece muchas ventajas.
b2-35-03.english: It is true that the plan is expensive, but it offers many advantages.
b2-35-03.canDo: I can grant a point with *si bien es cierto que* and then limit it.

b2-35-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A Formal Letter
b2-35-04.scenario: You are Carlos. You start a formal letter to a man you do not know, to ask for information.
b2-35-04.prompt: Write the opening and the reason for writing.
cues: Say you are writing to ask for information
b2-35-04.target: Estimado señor: Le escribo para pedirle información.
b2-35-04.english: Dear Sir, I am writing to ask you for information.
b2-35-04.canDo: I can open a formal letter with *Estimado señor:* or *Estimada señora:*.

b2-35-05.title: Communicative Challenge: After the Class
b2-35-05.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks what you and your classmates did when the class was over. You left together.
b2-35-05.prompt: Tell Carlos with a participle clause.
b2-35-05.english: Once the class was over, we left together.
b2-35-05.canDo: I can open a clause with a participle that agrees with its noun, as in *Terminada la reunión, salimos*.

b2-35-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Who Was Arguedas?
b2-35-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks who José María Arguedas was, after you both read a short text about him.
b2-35-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg who Arguedas was and when he died.
cues: Say what he was and where he was from
b2-35-consolidation.target: José María Arguedas fue un escritor peruano; murió en 1969.
b2-35-consolidation.english: José María Arguedas was a Peruvian writer; he died in 1969.
b2-35-consolidation.canDo: I can read a short text about José María Arguedas and his novel Los ríos profundos.
